mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 1% MoM but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 2% month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 2% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 jobs per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and negatively impact corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-interest-rate environment that will erode the real value of equity cash flows and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is growing by more than 2% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a favorable environment for corporate earnings that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
